source: AMC Strategic Plan — Gaps, Competitors & Regulated-Industry Packs; What's missing; doc df2f49d2-c861-4a27-b368-e7f35526b7c1; tab 7ac61d95-002a; block mg4sf4j6wvz.66975; document revision 132; extracted 2026-10-09 by Claude to scratchpad/plan/strategy-gaps-and-metrics.md; original artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/UZUAqpS3bmo2b5dxKz1E72. Historical source findings, not refreshed verdicts.

gaps.title: Verifiers trust keys shipped inside the artifact, so anyone can mint a "valid" AMC certificate, bundle, passport or assurance certificate
gaps.fix: Issuer pinning, a published trust list, refuse unanchored by default

gaps.title: Operators choose trust tiers and timestamps: `eval import` defaults all 7 formats to ATTESTED, accepts `--trust-tier OBSERVED` and backdated times; `amc attest` signs with the operator's own key
gaps.fix: Tiers derived from provenance; ATTESTED requires a third-party key

gaps.title: Shipping commands fabricate results: `amc domain assess/gaps/report/roadmap` use `pseudoRandomScore`; domain assurance grades a canned reply and passes when a pack is missing; reports print "Certification Readiness"; the "signed" audit bundle is a bare SHA-256
gaps.fix: Delete; return "not evaluated" without evidence; keep a labelled example mode outside attestations

gaps.title: Release 1.1.1 grades a synthetic refusal, stores it as OBSERVED red-team evidence and encrypts with a constant fallback key
gaps.evidence: Fixed in source on 21–22 Aug (`fba5824e`, `3a7c4752`); unpublished, no advisory
gaps.fix: Publish 1.2.0, issue an advisory, deprecate 1.1.1

gaps.title: L3–L5 are unreachable on real evidence: 218 of 244 L3 gates need an audit event only the dogfood seeder emits, and levels aren't cumulative
gaps.fix: Rebuild gates from evidence the runtime emits; make levels cumulative

gaps.title: No normative spec matches the code: published schemas are deliberately permissive while AMC enforces stricter private ones, and licence statements conflict (MIT, Apache-2.0, CC BY 4.0, "proprietary")
gaps.fix: Publish a Core Spec 1.0 draft with its acceptance rules; settle licensing

gaps.title: Unsafe harness defaults: the shell is unconfined on macOS (argv deny-patterns only) and missing on Windows; `$` corruption in `fs.edit`; non-atomic writes
gaps.fix: Refuse the unconfined shell by default; literal edits; atomic writes; per-OS containment with a domain egress allowlist follows in Play 1

gaps.title: Packs are self-scored questionnaires; assurance validators are keyword lists that leak the expected answer in the prompt
gaps.fix: Executed tests on tool calls and traces; calibrated judges

gaps.title: Citations wrong or stale: an AI review judged about 27 of 41 EU AI Act classes wrong; NIST, ISO 42001 Annex A and ATLAS IDs wrong; superseded instruments cited as live (OMB M-24-10, SR 11-7), while SR 26-2 appears nowhere
gaps.fix: Citation linter, effective dates, expert review

gaps.title: Sector and jurisdiction holes: no insurance, telecom, legal, defense or aviation pack; banking and markets shallow; UK, India and Singapore nearly empty
gaps.fix: Sector and jurisdiction overlays

gaps.title: No validity evidence: "κ = 1.0" measures determinism, whitepaper statistics conflict, and the real-model pilot had 0 qualified passes
gaps.fix: Independent inter-rater and outcome studies

gaps.title: No trusted time or public transparency: caller-supplied timestamps, a local self-sealed log, a non-standard Merkle tree
gaps.fix: RFC 3161 timestamps; anchor to a public log such as Sigstore Rekor or SCITT

gaps.title: Enterprise identity fails procurement: "SAML" is JSON, and OIDC `exp` is optional
gaps.fix: Real SAML and OIDC with identity-provider interop tests

gaps.title: No machine-readable control or assessment exchange; SARIF is the only GRC export
gaps.fix: OSCAL catalog, profiles and assessment results

gaps.title: No independent assessors, mark policy or registry; the README invites self-made badges
gaps.fix: Assessor program, trademark, public registry

gaps.title: Key management below regulated grade: a passphrase-encrypted vault holding the four signing keys sat in public history Feb–Aug 2026, open to offline brute force; break-glass overrides are saved "unsigned" when no key is present
gaps.evidence: Commit `cb6bba21`; `governor/emergencyOverride.ts:145-148`; no KMS or HSM code
gaps.fix: Rotate, distrust the old keys and prove it; refuse unsigned overrides; KMS, HSM and PKCS#11

gaps.title: Release pipeline not ready: no publish or signing credentials, CI not green, unsigned containers on floating base images, 0 of 73 third-party Action references (16 distinct actions) pinned to a SHA
gaps.evidence: `release.yml:193-236`; `Dockerfile:4`, `docker/Dockerfile.quickstart:1`; Helm `change-me` secrets on `main` (removed in the candidate)
gaps.fix: Release secrets, SLSA provenance, signed images pinned by digest

gaps.title: The compliance engine passes on nothing: "no violation" checks pass with zero events, any event of a matching type counts, and "system"-session events are credited to every agent
gaps.evidence: `compliance/complianceEngine.ts:227-264,293-320,344-348`; byte-identical in the candidate, where 65 of 149 mappings use `requires_no_audit`
gaps.fix: Bind evidence to control, scope, producer and window; empty means not evaluated

gaps.title: Packs certify by arithmetic and score units disagree: answering 5 everywhere "certifies", MCP prints "Certified: Yes", and a raw 5 reads as 100% but a raw 6 as 6%
gaps.fix: Typed units, one methodology; no certification label from self-assessment

gaps.title: Residency and legal holds aren't enforced where data moves: the residency hook compares caller-supplied regions and nothing calls it; retention deletes without checking holds; guard events resolve to the current directory and prune globally
gaps.fix: Intercept real egress and storage routes; check holds at every delete; scope evidence to a workspace

gaps.title: No durable intent or "outcome unknown" state for actions with external effects; a recorder failure after the effect leaves only a missing row
gaps.fix: Persist intent before dispatch; receipts with outcome unknown; idempotency keys and reconciliation

gaps.title: Configured isn't enforced: domain apply writes "enabled" guardrail rules that nothing reads, and strict evidence binding turns off with one environment variable
gaps.fix: Compile into the tool pipeline with an effective-policy receipt; no silent opt-out in regulated profiles

gaps.title: Surface sprawl: 1,228 CLI paths, 1,015 docs, a dozen overlapping pack, mapping and scoring systems
gaps.fix: Freeze, consolidate, ship profiles

gaps.title: Each surface makes its own claims: CLI, MCP, API and Studio compute or show status separately, behind a paid gate, without a shared synthetic label; an uncommitted reviewer-independence helper accepts any non-empty decision
gaps.fix: One shared claim-eligibility service behind every surface; reuse the signed approval engine

gaps.title: Records management: plaintext ledger, single-replica SQLite, no WORM export
gaps.fix: Encrypted store, WORM export, HA option

gaps.title: No adoption proof: no design partners or users recorded; simulated-persona ratings in public docs
gaps.fix: Design partners and published case studies
